create_nn_linear: create a torch.nn.Linear module with specified input and output features and optional bias
create_nn_bilinear: create a torch.nn.Bilinear module with two input feature sizes and one output feature size
create_nn_identity: create a torch.nn.Identity module that passes input tensors through unchanged
create_nn_lazy_linear: create a torch.nn.LazyLinear module that infers input features from the first forward pass
test_nn_linear_reset_parameters: test the torch.nn.Linear reset_parameters method to reinitialize weights and bias
